name: Slater Park Summer Camp
description_short: A summer camp at Slater Park run by the City of Pawtucket. The city publishes an information and registration packet with dates and registration requirements.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: 2026 SLATER PARK SUMMER CAMP INFO. PACKET - City of Pawtucket

warnings: Old season: this page covers the 2026 season, and today (2026-10-13) that summer is already over. Check whether there is a 2027 packet.
This is a City of Pawtucket announcement page. The camp details (dates, ages, prices) are in the linked PDF, which was not part of the source text.
The page says 'Registration opens this Friday, May 1st' (2026). This date was not recorded as a session because no sessions are listed.
The only address and phone on the page are for Pawtucket City Hall (137 Roosevelt Avenue, (401) 728-0500). These are the city's general contact details, not the camp's, so they were not recorded.
